dairy.name: Dairy Farming (పాడి పరిశ్రమ)
dairy.demandSeasonality: Peak demand during festival seasons (Sankranti, Dussehra, wedding season Oct-Feb); lower yield during peak summer (Apr-May).
dairy.competitorDensity: Moderate (typically 3 to 6 local milk producers per village cluster; strong absorption by dairy cooperatives like Vijaya, Amul, Mulkanoor).
keyRisks: Disease outbreaks (e.g. Foot and Mouth Disease)
Delayed payment cycles from private collection agents
recommendedActions: Secure supply contract with local dairy cooperative
Invest in silage / dry fodder storage before summer
Ensure cattle insurance coverage under Livestock Insurance Scheme

poultry.name: Country / Broiler Poultry (నాటు కోళ్ల / బ్రాయిలర్ ఫారమ్)
poultry.demandSeasonality: High demand weekends and non-fasting months; sharp dips during Shravana and Karthika masam.
poultry.competitorDensity: High for broiler contract farming; Low to moderate for free-range country chicken (Natukodi).
keyRisks: High mortality rates in extreme summer heat
Sudden retail price drops driven by commercial integrators
recommendedActions: Focus on indigenous Natukodi breeds with premium margins
Install foggers or sprinkler cooling for summer heat mitigation

kirana.name: Rural Grocery / Kirana Store (కిరాణా & జనరల్ స్టోర్)
kirana.demandSeasonality: Steady baseline throughout year; surges during post-harvest harvest settlement and festivals.
kirana.competitorDensity: High (almost 5 to 10 village shops within 1 km radius). Differentiation requires credit management & digital payments.
recommendedActions: Strict 15-day limit on customer credit ledger
Stock fast-moving regional brands and regional snacks
Adopt UPI QR code payment system for faster settlements

weaving.name: Handloom / Powerloom Weaving (చేనేత / పవర్లూమ్ వస్త్రాలు)
weaving.demandSeasonality: Strong festive and wedding peaks (August through February); monsoon lull.
weaving.competitorDensity: Clustered in specific weaving villages (e.g. Pochampally, Gadwal, Mangalagiri, Sircilla). Direct market access beats middlemen.
keyRisks: Counterfeit powerloom replicas sold as handloom
recommendedActions: Register under Handloom Mark and Weaver Credit Card Scheme
Form direct tie-ups with Dastkar, GoCoop, or regional craft exhibitions

tailoring.name: Tailoring & Boutique (టైలరింగ్ & రెడీమేడ్)
tailoring.demandSeasonality: Extreme surges during marriage season and school reopening (May-June).
tailoring.competitorDensity: Moderate to high. Artisanship, timeliness, and maggam embroidery create strong moat.
keyRisks: Single-person dependency and delivery delays during rush season
Frequent power cuts affecting electric sewing/ironing machines
recommendedActions: Acquire motorized industrial machine with inverter backup
Add computer embroidery / maggam work service for higher margins

agri_processing.name: Agri-Processing & Flour / Spice Mill (పిండి మిల్లు & చిరుధాన్యాల ప్రాసెసింగ్)
agri_processing.demandSeasonality: Post-harvest harvest surges (March-April for Rabi, Nov-Dec for Kharif). Consistent weekly household milling.
agri_processing.competitorDensity: Low to moderate (usually 1-2 mills per village cluster of 2,000 households).
keyRisks: Dust hazard and safety risks without proper ventilation
Seasonal dip during lean agricultural months
recommendedActions: Install automated motor starter with phase preventer
Expand into packaged branded millet flours and turmeric powder
